definitions.explanation: When a store has run out of a particular item and has none available. Often implies the item may be restocked later.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません→申し訳ありません：21409_moushiwakearimasen⟧、{品切|しなぎ}れです。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{現在|げんざい}→現在：01556_genzai⟧{品切|しなぎ}れ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧です。
examples.english: That product is currently out of stock.

examples.japanese: {品切|しなぎ}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{入荷|にゅうか}→入荷：07939_nyuuka⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧お⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If it's out of stock, please wait until the next shipment arrives.

notes:
{品切|しなぎ}れ indicates that an item is temporarily unavailable because the store's stock has run out. It implies the item may be restocked, unlike ⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れ→売り切れ：09556_urikire⟧ which emphasizes that all items were sold.

COMPOUND: ⟦{品|しな}→品：03192_shina⟧ (goods) + {切|き}れ (run out)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {品切|しなぎ}れ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: currently out of stock
- {品切|しなぎ}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to go out of stock
- {品切|しなぎ}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧: in case of being out of stock
- {品切|しなぎ}れ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: out-of-stock item

COMPARISON WITH {売|う}り{切|き}れ:
- {品切|しなぎ}れ: focuses on inventory status (may be restocked)
- ⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れ→売り切れ：09556_urikire⟧: focuses on sales result (everything was sold, often implies it won't return)

USAGE:
Commonly seen on signs in stores and on e-commerce websites. Staff may say {品切|しなぎ}れです when apologizing to customers.
